
/// G10-3 夹具生成器（不入库：只在生成时临时贴进 native/fushi_fsrs/src/store/gen4/prepare_tests.rs 末尾跑
/// `FUSHI_G103_OUT=<目录> cargo test --profile quick --lib generate_g10_3_server_fixture -- --ignored`）：两个 profile 的
/// 协议 3 库（schema 29）——[P] 有笔记 / 复习、协议 3 迁移做完；[ORPHAN] 只在投影表里（一副牌组 + 一条旧复习日志），
/// 写到 `FUSHI_G103_OUT/srs.db`；再拿生成的这份走一次全局命令迁移，确认能提交。
#[test]
#[ignore]
fn generate_g10_3_server_fixture() {
    let Ok(out) = std::env::var("FUSHI_G103_OUT") else {
        return;
    };
    let dir = unsynced_dir("g103-fixture", &|d| {
        while d.core.sync2_migrate(P, T0, None).unwrap()["done"] != json!(true) {}
        let w = d.core.writer().unwrap();
        w.execute(
            "INSERT INTO srs_entities (id, profile_uid, kind, payload_json, created_at) VALUES (srs_id(?1), srs_id(?2), 'deck', '{\"createdAt\":1}', 1)",
            params![default_deck_id(ORPHAN), ORPHAN],
        )
        .unwrap();
        legacy_log(
            &w,
            ORPHAN,
            "0193a1b2-0000-7000-8000-0000000000e9",
            "0193a1b2-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c9",
            T0 - 600,
        );
    });
    {
        let c = raw(&dir.0);
        c.execute_batch("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);").unwrap();
    }
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(out);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&out).unwrap();
    std::fs::copy(dir.0.join(LEGACY_FILE), out.join(LEGACY_FILE)).unwrap();
    let check = tempdir::new("g103-fixture-check");
    std::fs::copy(out.join(LEGACY_FILE), check.0.join(LEGACY_FILE)).unwrap();
    let mut listed = listed_profiles(&check.0);
    listed.sort();
    let mut want = vec![P.to_owned(), ORPHAN.to_owned()];
    want.sort();
    assert_eq!(listed, want);
    let caches: serde_json::Map<String, Value> = listed
        .iter()
        .map(|p| (p.clone(), serde_json::from_str(&cfg_of(p)).unwrap()))
        .collect();
    let r = global(
        "gen4_migrate_run",
        &json!({"dir": check.0.to_str().unwrap(), "caches": caches, "now": NOW}),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r["verdict"], json!("committed"), "{r:#}");
}
